text.en: It's a single rotation step: depending on the direction bit, you add or subtract the two signed vectors to get the new x and new y.
text.es: Es un solo paso de rotación: según el bit de dirección, sumas o restas los dos vectores con signo para obtener la nueva x y la nueva y.

text.en: It's purely combinational with `signed` arithmetic: cast `x_in`/`y_in` to `signed`, choose add vs subtract with a `when dir='1' else` conditional, and cast each result back to `std_logic_vector`.
text.es: Es puramente combinacional con aritmética `signed`: convierte `x_in`/`y_in` a `signed`, elige sumar o restar con un condicional `when dir='1' else`, y devuelve cada resultado a `std_logic_vector`.

text.en:
Note that x and y use the opposite operator for the same direction.
```vhdl
x_out <= std_logic_vector(signed(x_in) - signed(y_in)) when dir = '1'
    else std_logic_vector(signed(x_in) + signed(y_in));
y_out <= std_logic_vector(signed(y_in) + signed(x_in)) when dir = '1'
    else std_logic_vector(signed(y_in) - signed(x_in));
```
text.es:
Fíjate en que x e y usan el operador opuesto para la misma dirección.
```vhdl
x_out <= std_logic_vector(signed(x_in) - signed(y_in)) when dir = '1'
    else std_logic_vector(signed(x_in) + signed(y_in));
y_out <= std_logic_vector(signed(y_in) + signed(x_in)) when dir = '1'
    else std_logic_vector(signed(y_in) - signed(x_in));
```
